items.item_text: Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Bachelor's Degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training

The Executive Assistant to Dr. Owen Witte provides independent operational, managerial, and analytical support to Dr. Owen Witte. The executive assistant provides crucial support for the PI, including maintaining a complex calendar, organizing correspondences, coordinating and arranging logistics for executive-level meetings, and arranging for occasional travel and processing travel reimbursements. The executive assistant ensures the smooth day-to-day operations of the Witte Lab and works to support Dr. Witte in his capacity as Chair of the Immunology Advisory Committee, which awards intramural research grants to immunology researchers across the campus.
Proven success organizing travel arrangements and keeping track of multiple calendars.
Excellent organizational skills with impeccable attention to detail.
Working knowledge of campus on-line systems such as Bruin Buy Plus, recharge systems and facilities service requests.
Ability to handle administrative tasks independently and to develop and enhance systems for maximizing efficiency and ensuring successful execution of tasks and projects.
Exceptional time management skills and the ability to follow tasks through to completion and work effectively and productively under a heavy workload with frequent interruptions.

Ability to maintain confidentiality at all times; uses discretion, confidentiality, and good judgment to handle Dr. Witte’s business matters. Ability to analyze and resolve problems independently, and know when to escalate issues.

Proven verbal and written communication skills to relay complex information clearly, concisely, accurately, and diplomatically; Demonstrated English writing skills to produce original correspondence, reports, and other documents utilizing business etiquette, correct spelling, grammar and syntax.
Proficiency in MS Office with Word processing skills to prepare memos, letters, and documents with speed and accuracy.
Functions effectively and efficiently as a member of a team and in collaboration with colleagues; Professional and poised nature; ability to keep calm in high-stress situations.
Excellent interpersonal skills to interact effectively and diplomatically with University officials, faculty, staff, donors, volunteers and the public.
Ability to transport packages up to 15 lbs. and other materials to on- and off-campus sites.
Working knowledge of University purchasing and accounts payable policies/procedures and travel and entertainment policies.
